units.source_text: 源氏公子召集附近领地里的吏目，命令他们从事土木工程；

en.t: Prince Genji summoned the officials from nearby estates and ordered them to undertake construction work;

units.source_text: 就把同来的良清当作亲近的家臣，教他仰承公子意旨而指挥吏目。

en.t: he treated Yoshikiyo, who had come with him, as a trusted retainer and had him direct the officials according to the prince's wishes.

units.source_text: 对于这样的安排，公子又不胜今昔之感。

en.t: This arrangement again filled the prince with overpowering feelings about the contrast between past and present.

units.source_text: 过了不久，土木工程已楚楚可观。

en.t: Before long, the construction work had become neat and impressive to behold.

units.source_text: 又命将池水加深，庭木加多，心情渐渐安定下来，但亦像做梦一般。

en.t: He also ordered the pond to be deepened and more garden trees to be planted, and although his heart gradually settled, it all still felt like a dream.

units.source_text: 这摄津国的国守，也是以前亲信的从臣。

en.t: The governor of Settsu Province was also a former attendant whom he had once trusted closely.

units.source_text: 此人不忘旧情，时时暗中照拂。

en.t: This man did not forget their old bond and quietly looked after him from time to time.

units.source_text: 这住处便不再像一个旅舍，而是天天有许多人出入了。

en.t: His residence no longer seemed like a mere lodging place, for many people now came and went there every day.

units.source_text: 然而终无情投意合之人可以共话，仍有远客他乡之感，心情不免郁结。

en.t: Yet there was still no kindred spirit with whom he could speak openly, and he continued to feel like a distant guest in a foreign place, so his heart could not help growing heavy.

units.source_text: 常忧今后岁月，不知如何排遣。

en.t: He was constantly troubled about the years ahead and did not know how he would pass them.
